title: Service Communication Breakdown: Orders to Users
description: The orders service is having trouble reaching the user service. Can you identify and fix the misconfiguration?

problemStatement.situation: Recently, the orders-service has begun failing to retrieve user data, causing errors in processing orders. It's suspected that a recent configuration change may have introduced a service communication issue.
tasks: Inspect the orders-service logs to identify the error messages.
Check the API endpoint configurations in the orders-service.
Correct the endpoint URL to enable successful communication.
problemStatement.scoring: orders-service successfully retrieves data from user-service without errors in logs
